angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 73,187,640 km at 39034.20 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12815: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 39034.2 +/- 3812 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 39034.2 +/- 3812 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0171 +/- 0.0157 mas (same row, RUWE 1.49), -1.1 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 105.2 +/- 11 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12815: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 105.2 +/- 11 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 73,187,640 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5125 +/- 88 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC4066, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5125 +/- 88 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC4066, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5125 +/- 88 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559)
limbDisplayGravitySource: no gravity of this star is published (none in SIMBAD); Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, table 3 (the spectroscopic gravities of its Cepheid spectra) gives the class's range, log g -1.33 to 2.86. Across log g 0 to 2.85, the part the grid covers, the limb laws differ by at most 1.9% of the centre brightness from the one drawn, at log g 0.85, the gravity closest to all of them; log g 0.85 is a display choice, not a measurement (https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/VizieR?-source=J/AJ/156/171/table3)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, SV* HV 12815: main object type cC*, Classical Cepheid Variable

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
